content: Hi how can i assist you today
Wind chimes outside my window answer yes/no questions. The pattern feels deliberate.
Chime movement follows gusts and airflow. When you heard the ‘yes’ or ‘no,’ what were the wind conditions—steady breeze, sudden gusts?
Usually short gusts after I think a question.
A weather app’s minute-by-minute wind graph next to your notes could show whether gust timing aligns with what you perceived as replies.
So compare gust spikes to chime bursts.
Yes—if bursts cluster around recorded gusts on calm days versus windy days, that points to weather rather than coded answers.
I can log wind and chime time for a few evenings.
That side-by-side view tends to make the relationship clearer.
